subject: Request: temporary trial top-up while connector fix is completed
messages:
From: Liam Thompson <liam@finserve.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sandbox uplift request — connector blocking our POC

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

We're running into a blocker on our side while wiring up your S3 connector — the upload job is failing intermittently and the ingestion team needs a couple more days to validate fixes. We were planning to run a burst of generation to validate prompt tuning and cost projections this week, but with the connector unstable we can't exercise the flows end-to-end.

Can Redwood temporarily top up our trial credits (or extend the trial end date) so we can continue model/proxy testing while the team finishes the fix? Specifically: 1) a short token top-up (~200k tokens) to re-run the prompt sweep, and 2) an extension of the sandbox expiry by two weeks.

Attaching the error logs we've been seeing. Happy to hop on a quick call with Karthik if it helps clarify the failure mode.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Thompson
Head of Integrations, FinServe AI
liam@finserve.ai

-----Original Attachment(s): connector_error_log.txt (text), SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (pdf)

----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam Thompson <liam@finserve.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandbox uplift request — connector blocking our POC

Liam — thanks for the note and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear you're blocked.

Short answer: we can help. I want to capture the ask clearly so billing and engineering can action quickly:
- Temporary token top-up: ~200k tokens (one-time)
- Trial extension: +14 days from current expiry

Looping in Karthik (solutions) to confirm the technical ETA for the connector fix, and Marcus (account) for credit/approval. Marissa, can you confirm if we need any procurement/contract sign-off to push credits to this sandbox instance?

Next steps: Karthik, please reply with ETA and whether the sandbox can be switched to our alternate ingestion path while FinServe vets the connector patch. Marcus / Marissa, can you confirm credit limits we can grant without an amended SOW?

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Liam Thompson <liam@finserve.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandbox uplift request — connector blocking our POC

Thanks — dug into the logs Liam attached. The intermittent 503s look like a retry/backpressure issue on the customer's S3 proxy combined with a transient credential refresh race. We have two paths: 1) quick mitigation — increase client-side retries and use a short-lived presigned URL flow (low-effort), or 2) longer fix — update the connector to handle credentials refresh atomically.

ETA: If FinServe accepts mitigation (1), we can get a stable test harness by EOD tomorrow and you'll be unblocked. For the connector patch (2), our estimate is EOD 2026-11-18 for Redwood's reference implementation (we'll provide a patch and a short runbook).

Either way, I support giving the team the token top-up and a two-week extension so they can complete the prompt sweep and validate quality once ingestion is stable.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Thompson <liam@finserve.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandbox uplift request — connector blocking our POC

Team — per Liam's ask and Karthik's assessment, FinServe is requesting a 200k token uplift + 14-day extension. Deal: FS-3482 (POC phase).

Marcus — can we authorize a one-time credit top-up from our sandbox credit pool for POC customers? If procurement needs a note, I can provide a short email confirming it's a one-off courtesy so the POC stays live.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

- One-time sandbox credit: 200,000 tokens charged to Redwoods POC pool (internal GL: RD-POC-2026)
- Trial/sandbox expiry extended to 2026-11-30 for account FinServe AI (no contract amendment required)

Marissa — please log this in the billing ticket and notify procurement if they reach out. Liam — you'll get a confirmation email from billing once the tokens are added; ETA for credit posting is ~1 business day.

Marcus Lin
